sentences: A weighted set system can be compressed by retaining and reweighting only some of its coordinates.
The aim is to approximate the weight of every set multiplicatively at once.
The conjecture asks whether the required number of coordinates is proportional to chain length divided by the squared error parameter.
Chain length is measured in the union-closure of the family.
This would give a sharp structural sparsification bound and improve the understanding of special cases such as sparsifying linear codes.
